insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Jarvan IV is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Jarvan IV in 20/54 games (37%): 8 picks (4-4) and 12 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Azir? They go Anivia
insights.text: Azir is a G1 favorite (11/25 G1s, played by Jojopyun). In the 20 later games where it was burned or banned, Jojopyun went to Anivia (2/20) and Ryze (2/20).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: They fade once their pool is burned

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Teams respect-ban Varus against them
insights.text: Opponents banned Varus against them in 23/54 games (43%).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they go about as deep as the league
insights.text: In 14 G3+ games, 26/70 picks (37%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 42%). Pool: 48 champs in G1s, 52 in G3+.
